privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.tldrBody: We collect the minimum needed to run the app: an anonymous device ID (only after you check in), your language and theme choices, and — for admins — an email + password. No third-party analytics or advertising cookies are used. You can delete everything about you from this page.
privacy.s1Body: The data controller is Digiarendus OÜ (info@digiarendus.ee). Contact us at that address for any privacy question, request or complaint.
privacy.s2Intro: We only collect data that the app needs to function. Nothing is sold, and no data is shared with advertising networks.
privacy.s2Device: Anonymous device ID (dg_device cookie, 12 months): a random 32-character token stored on your device. Created only when you check in to a course, scan a course QR code, or subscribe to notifications. Used to remember your active check-in and to prevent duplicate rows if you scan twice. Legal basis: performance of the service you requested (ePrivacy Art 5(3)(b) exception; GDPR Art 6(1)(b)).
privacy.s2CheckIn: Check-in rows: course, timestamp, group size, and your device ID. Used to (a) show live player counts on the map so other players know how busy a course is, and (b) give course operators aggregated statistics (see "Analytics" below). Legal basis: legitimate interest of operators in understanding traffic on their own courses (GDPR Art 6(1)(f)); the data is pseudonymous and never enriched with your name, contact details or location.
privacy.s2Issue: Issue reports: category, message text, optional course, and your device ID (so we can group repeat reports). Legal basis: legitimate interest in maintaining the courses (GDPR Art 6(1)(f)). Do not put personal data in the message text.
privacy.s2Push: Push subscriptions: the push endpoint provided by your browser and the associated public keys. Stored only if you explicitly enable notifications. Legal basis: your consent (GDPR Art 6(1)(a)); revoked by turning notifications off in the app or in your browser.
privacy.s2Admin: Admin accounts: email + hashed password (scrypt) and the list of courses you manage. Only relevant if a course operator has been given an admin account. Legal basis: performance of the contract with the operator (GDPR Art 6(1)(b)).
privacy.s3Title: How the analytics dashboard uses your data
privacy.s3Body: Course admins can see aggregated numbers derived from check-in rows on their own courses only: total players and check-ins, unique visitors, returning-visitor rate, average party size and round length, busiest hour and weekday, a weekday × hour heatmap, and period-over-period changes. No admin ever sees individual device IDs, names or contact details — only totals and averages. Superusers can see the same aggregates across all courses.
privacy.s4Body: The data is stored on the app server (currently hosted in the European Economic Area). Map tiles are fetched from openstreetmap.org, which as a third-party service may see your IP address. Push notifications are delivered via your browser vendor (Apple, Google, Mozilla). No other third parties receive your data.
privacy.s5Body: Check-in rows: up to 24 months, then pruned automatically. Closed issue reports: up to 12 months, then pruned. Open issue reports: kept until they are resolved. Push subscriptions: removed when the browser reports the endpoint is invalid, or immediately when you turn notifications off. Admin accounts: kept while the admin holds the role; removed on request.
privacy.s6Body: Under GDPR you have the right to access, rectify, port, restrict processing of, or delete your data, and to object to processing based on legitimate interest. You can also lodge a complaint with the Estonian Data Protection Inspectorate (Andmekaitse Inspektsioon, https://www.aki.ee). For public visitors most of these rights are exercised via the "Delete my data" button below; for admin accounts write to info@digiarendus.ee.
privacy.s7Body: dg_device — anonymous device ID, only after check-in, 12 months, functional. NEXT_LOCALE — language preference, 12 months, functional. dg_admin — admin session, 24 hours, functional. theme — light/dark preference in localStorage, functional. cookie-ack-v1 — remembers that you dismissed the cookie notice, localStorage, functional. No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are set.
privacy.s8Body: We will update the "Last updated" date whenever this policy changes. Substantive changes will also be surfaced through the cookie notice on your next visit.
privacy.deleteBody: This removes every row keyed to your device: your check-in history, any issue reports you have submitted, and your push subscription. It also clears the dg_device cookie on your browser. Aggregated statistics do not include personal data and are unaffected.
privacy.deleteConfirm: Delete every check-in, issue report and push subscription tied to this device? This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteSuccess: Done — your data has been removed.
privacy.deleteSuccessDetail: Removed {checkIns} check-in(s), {issues} issue report(s), and {push} push subscription(s).
